description: Search the app store by keyword and return matching apps with pagination. Example: fortytwo_app_search({ platform: "ios", query: "racing games", limit: 20, page: 1, _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: 42matters API access token (get one at https://42matters.com/pricing).

platform.description: App store to query: "android" (Google Play) or "ios" (Apple App Store). Defaults to "android".

name: fortytwo_app_search
title: Fortytwo App Search
